title: LIFT: Scoped Constraints for Evaluating and Training Instruction Following
author: Eran Goldstein, Yuval Belfer, Yonatan Belinkov, Daniel Gissin
description: arXiv:2610.28819v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Common instruction following (IF) benchmarks, such as IFEval, evaluate the ability of language models (LMs) to follow simple constraints that can easily be verified programmatically. These same constraints, in turn, are used as reward signals for reinforcement learning.…
